label: Every CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause of a thing is a ground of it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, whatever sustains a thing's being (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2) is a ground of it under the supplied grounding relation of the lasting-ground premise A2ab. That relation's intended reading is the proximate ground of a thing's coming to be, per se or per accidens (DISAMB-CAUSAL-SERIES); a sustaining cause of being is a per se cause of being, so counting it among the grounds of a coming to be widens or reads that relation. Holds by definition if the grounding relation is taken to include sustaining causation.
